narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple kinetic conflicts escalate simultaneously: US-Iran active exchanges, Israel two-front operations, and deep Ukraine strikes. The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline and the Apache shootdown confirm that de-escalation is failing, forcing a repricing of geopolitical risk premia across equities, commodities, and crypto.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and short S&P 500 futures; overweight defense and energy equities, underweight consumer discretionary and tech.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The EIA's projection of a Hormuz blockade persisting through Q3 2026 and Kuwait's active pursuit of pipeline bypasses signal a structural supply disruption, not a transient spike. Capital is rotating into energy commodities and related infrastructure plays, while diplomatic progress claims are treated with skepticism given ongoing kinetic exchanges.
narratives.trade_implication: Buy WTI call spreads and energy infrastructure ETFs; short airlines and shipping equities exposed to fuel cost inflation.

narratives.title: Institutional DeFi and AI Adoption
narratives.summary: Despite macro risk-off, capital is selectively flowing into institutional-grade crypto and AI infrastructure. Janus Henderson's partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs and Anthropic's early release of Claude Fable signal that large asset managers and tech firms are accelerating deployment, decoupling from broader risk sentiment.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate Ethereum and select DeFi tokens (e.g., ENA) on dips; long AI infrastructure ETFs and short-dated tech calls.
